caption: R2 240 a month on things I don't use. How many of your debit orders can you name without looking?

slides.title:
The R2 240 I
forgot I was paying,
on R19 000 p/m
Living in Harrismith
slides.body:
Female, 35
Single, no kids
Job: Dental assistant
Net salary: R19 000 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: Quiet building, a short walk to the practice. I pay for that.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: Almost done. I've already spent the R3 300 in my head.

slides.title: Debit orders I forgot
slides.includes: Gym R599, extra DStv R489, insurance on a phone I sold R389, meal box R640, apps R123
slides.body: I found these on one statement. The gym I last visited in March.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.body: He's in Grade 11. This one I'd pay twice.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Pick n Pay, plus lunch supplies for work
slides.body: Cheaper than the meal box, which I'm only now admitting.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol, electricity, phone, hospital plan, funeral policy, stokvel
slides.body: The hospital plan is R640 and the stokvel is R500. Those two are on purpose.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R19 000. The forgotten debit orders alone are more than three times what's left.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and the recurring charges were listed in one place.

The phone insurance was the shock.

No bank login needed.
